request: Let me mark important tasks and focus on those first

questions.ask: When a task is marked important, should it automatically jump to the top of the list (above non-important tasks), or just get a visual marker (like a star) while staying in its current position?
questions.why: Determines whether we need to add sorting logic that reorders the list, or just add a toggle and a style change — a noticeably different amount of work and a different visual result.

questions.ask: Is 'important' a simple on/off flag (like a star you can toggle), or do you need multiple priority levels (e.g. low/medium/high)?
questions.why: An on/off flag is a small addition to the existing done/not-done toggle; multiple levels require a different data field and a way to pick between them, which is a bigger change.

questions.ask: Once a task is checked off as done, should it stay marked important, or should completing it clear the important mark?
questions.why: Determines whether completed tasks still sort/display as important, or drop out of that treatment once done — affects the sort/display rule we build.

findings.note: Frontend renders a flat task list from GET /api/tasks with no sorting; each item only has a done checkbox and title, added via toggleDone(). Marking important would need a new UI control and a render-order change.

Express API backed by SQLite; tasks table only has id, title, done. PATCH /api/tasks/:id currently only updates 'done'. Adding importance requires a new column and extending the PATCH handler (and likely GET ordering).
Schema is defined here (id, title, done INTEGER). No 'important' or priority column exists yet — would need to be added and seed data updated.
Minimal markup: just a form and a <ul> for tasks; no existing star/priority UI pattern to reuse.

reply: A separate view, not re-sorting the main list. Just on and off, no levels. And it should stay important even after it's done.

spec.summary: Add an on/off 'important' flag to tasks, toggleable per task, with a separate Important view listing only those tasks (main list stays unsorted and unchanged); the flag persists after a task is completed.
acceptance: Each task in the main list has a toggle control to mark/unmark it important.
Toggling a task's important flag does not change its position or the order of the main list.
A separate view (e.g. an 'Important' tab/page) shows only tasks currently marked important.
Marking a task done does not clear its important flag, and it remains visible in the Important view after completion.
Unmarking important removes the task from the Important view without changing its done state.
Refreshing the page preserves each task's important flag (persisted server-side).
unchanged: Existing done/checkbox toggle behavior and its API contract for the 'done' field.
spec.check: Automated check must prove: PATCH toggling 'important' persists the flag in the database; GET of the main task list returns tasks in the same order regardless of important status; a request scoped to important tasks returns exactly the subset with important=true; toggling 'done' on an important task leaves important=true afterward.
spec.reviewFocus: Confirm the PATCH /api/tasks/:id handler never resets 'important' to false as a side effect of updating 'done' (completing a task must not silently clear its important mark).
